_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Contracts CI forge-test matrix.
`.github/workflows/contracts-ci.yml` builds its matrix from this file via
asserts that every contracts/test/**/*.t.sol is claimed by exactly one slice
or by an explicit `excluded` entry. Keeping the patterns here (rather than
inline in the workflow) is deliberate: a guard that carries its own private
copy of the pattern list can pass while the matrix runs nothing.
`pattern` is a GLOB, not a regex — it is passed verbatim to
* `*` does NOT cross `/`. `test/*.t.sol` reaches no subdirectory of test/.
* regex syntax (`|`, `$`, `\.`) is matched LITERALLY and silently finds
nothing, because forge exits 0 on 'No tests found in project!'.
`noMatchTest` is the shared `--no-match-test` regex applied to every slice.
It filters by TEST NAME, so any test whose name contains Fuzz/Invariant is
skipped in PR-blocking CI regardless of which slice its file lands in.

excluded.reason: Stateful invariant suites: 35 `invariant_*` handlers, plus 2 ordinary unit tests named `test_invariant_*` (both in TegridyLending_RewardAttributionInvariants.t.sol). The shared `noMatchTest` filter strips ALL 37 — the handlers by kind, those 2 purely because their NAMES contain 'invariant' — so a slice pointed here would run ZERO tests and still exit 0, which is the exact failure this manifest exists to prevent. NOT RUN BY ANY WORKFLOW TODAY: older comments in contracts-ci.yml claim a 'nightly cron on a beefier runner' picks these up, but no such workflow was ever created (there is no `schedule:` trigger for contracts anywhere in .github/workflows). Running the handlers needs a dedicated job with a longer timeout and its own --no-match-test, not a matrix slice. The 2 misfiled unit tests are cheap and deterministic and belong at test/ root under a name without 'invariant' in it — tracked separately.

Echidna property definitions (`echidna_*`). forge's collector only picks up `test*` / `invariant_*`, so `forge test` finds zero runnable tests in this directory no matter what pattern points at it. Requires the `echidna` binary, which is not installed in this workflow.
Halmos symbolic specs (`check_*`). Same story as echidna: forge collects zero tests from these files. Requires the `halmos` binary, which is not installed in this workflow.
